_comment: ll-skills suggested machine policy. The installer PRINTS this file and never writes it; the owner applies it to ~/.claude/settings.json via /update-config. Blocking belongs in permissions.deny, not in PreToolUse hooks (Bash matching is best-effort). Prompt cache of 1h keeps the Fable session and the immutable PLAN.md cacheable; /effort does not invalidate the cache on Fable 5.1. autoCompactWindow 900k replaces the 500k currently on this machine.
